items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: But we got Dink. Wills and Spice had to go Dink. I don't know. Something. I don't know. We got a hold of him.

ctx.x: Wade had been with you all that time?
Yeah. But we got Dink. Wills and Spice had to go Dink. I don't know. Something. I don't know. We got a hold of him. I don't know.
Well, they did one of Dink's tunes too. That was the Ticket Blues. Yeah.
